notes.title: Some fixes after the first weekend!
notes.content:
Today is the day!

Ignited Steel free update UPRISING now available on your Steam library if you already own the game!

If you don’t, take your chance and[b] save a 25%[/b] buying the game during this first week discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/7296b5ec80a7b7b542e6d6d7f7cfb1bbbaf858d8.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550740/Ignited_Steel_Mech_Tactics/][b]Get the game here![/b][/url]

If you like the game please, tell a friend! Spread the word and let them know that you love Ignited Steel!

Don’t hesitate to contact us and share your feedback of the new content of Ignited Steel: Uprising!


We would also like to say thanks to all the feedback you are giving us, we have fixed some of thebugs you have been reporting.

[hr][/hr]
Hotfixes:

  - Fixed bug that prevented the game from booting up in some cases.
  - Added missing localized text strings.
  - Solved event reward that would let player mechs deal x100 damage.

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for your help, do not hesitate to keep sending us this kind of info!

See you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42526365/1c1776ccb957de830a9f0c1491e1f23a5cea99ee.png[/img]
